scripts.translation: 我說，我聽不懂你在說什麼。

scripts.text: Anyway, I looking for things that can only find in this place. If you found them, gimme them.
scripts.translation: 總之，我在找只有這裡才有的東西。你要是找到了，就賣給我吧。

scripts.text: I'll pay you good. You welcomes all the time.
scripts.translation: 我會出個好價錢，隨時歡迎你來。

scripts.text: What have you brought my today?
Mm, do you want your things back?
Mm? Where are they? The things you said will give me.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你說要給我的東西呢？

scripts.text: It good business. These I didn't see anywhere else. I like them very much!
scripts.translation: 這筆買賣不錯。這些東西別處都見不到，我很喜歡！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我帶的物品種類太多了。得先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: What? I don't have enough food for you!
scripts.translation: 什麼？我沒有多餘的食物給你！

scripts.text: Hey, don't you see the line over there? I don't care who you are? go stand in line if you want to eat.
scripts.translation: 喂，沒看見那邊排著隊嗎？不管你是誰，想吃東西就去排隊！

scripts.text: You're not here to eat. Err, is that...? Ah, my apologies.
scripts.translation: 你不是來吃東西的？呃，那是...？啊，抱歉。

scripts.text: Wait, then why are you bothering me? Can't you see I'm upset because of the missing shipment?
scripts.translation: 那你來煩我幹什麼？沒看見貨物不見了，我正心煩嗎？

scripts.text: Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 嘖，你這人真討厭。我沒空跟你廢話。快走！

scripts.text: Look at that. Those people have been waiting for their food for hours. How can I tell them that I don't have enough ingredients to cook for them?
scripts.translation: 你看那些人，排了好幾個小時，就等著領飯。我該怎麼告訴他們，我沒有足夠的食材給他們做飯？

scripts.text: The food ingredients that were supposed to come from Midgard didn't arrive, and I can't keep these people waiting.
scripts.translation: 本該從米德加爾特送來的食材一直沒到，我不能讓大家繼續等下去。

scripts.text: Why don't you procure some ingredients from the outside?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼不從外面想辦法弄些食材？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Good luck.
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 嘖，你這人真討厭。我沒空跟你廢話。快走！

scripts.text: I thought about it. I was desperate enough to try anything.
scripts.translation: 我也考慮過了。當時真是急瘋了，什麼辦法都想試。

scripts.text: But there are only sand and rocks out there, and nothing edible. I can't believe I thought I could run a kitchen in a place like this.
scripts.translation: 可外面除了沙子和石頭什麼都沒有，根本找不到能吃的東西。我真不敢相信自己竟想在這種地方開廚房。

scripts.text: ^990000Wait, did you just say you have no ingredients? You ran out of them?^000000
scripts.translation: 等等，你剛才說沒有食材了？都用光了嗎？ ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000No, I didn't say that! It's just taking a little longer to cook today. Stop panicking!^000000
scripts.translation: 不，我可沒這麼說！只是今天做飯要多花點時間。別慌！ ^990000^000000

scripts.text: Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 嘖，你這人真討厭。我沒空跟你廢話。快走！

scripts.text: You need food ingredients, don't you?
Alright, then let's do this. I'll jot down everything I need. Can you bring them from Midgard?
scripts.translation: 好，那就這麼辦。我把要的東西列下來。你能從米德加爾特帶來嗎？

scripts.text: It'd be a waste of my time if I say no now.
scripts.translation: 現在拒絕的話，我這趟不就白費口舌了。

scripts.text: Good! We've made a deal. I need some time to take inventory. Talk to me again later.
scripts.translation: 好！一言為定。我得花點時間盤點，待會兒再來找我。

scripts.text: This should be enough for the day today.
Aww, here's the list of ingredients I need. Bring them quickly, will you?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，這是我需要的食材清單。快點帶來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, come on. Help me out here. People are starving.
scripts.translation: 拜託，幫幫忙吧。大家都快餓壞了。

scripts.text: Sweet potato croquettes are on the menu today, and I can't make them because I didn't get the regular shipment from the mainland.
scripts.translation: 今天選單上有紅薯可樂餅，可我沒收到大陸送來的常規貨物，做不了。

scripts.text: Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶160個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}

scripts.text: There are so many mouths to feed, and yet I've got no meat? This is disaster!
scripts.translation: 這麼多張嘴等著吃飯，我手頭卻連肉都沒有？這下糟了！

scripts.text: What? I could always feed them veggies, you say? Sure, but all they want is meat.
scripts.translation: 什麼？你說可以給他們吃蔬菜？是可以，可他們想吃的都是肉。

scripts.text: Bring me 50 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶50個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}

scripts.text: Have you seen the carrots growing in the garden in the back?
scripts.translation: 你看到後院菜園裡種的胡蘿蔔了嗎？

scripts.text: They're as thin as fingers, and once I almost put my fingers into a stew instead of them.
scripts.translation: 它們細得跟手指似的，有次我差點把自己的手指當胡蘿蔔丟進燉鍋裡。

scripts.text: Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶160個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}

scripts.text: I shouldn't have put that banana bread on the menu. Who knew they wouldn't arrive in time?
scripts.translation: 我真不該把香蕉麵包寫進選單。誰知道貨送不到呢？

scripts.text: Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶160個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}

scripts.text: I have to cook a pumpkin stew, but I don't have pumpkins. This is the equivalent of making toast without bread.
scripts.translation: 我得做南瓜濃湯，可手頭沒有南瓜。這就像沒有面包卻要做吐司。

scripts.text: Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶160個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}

scripts.text: The only thing I can cook with the ingredients I have is mushroom soup, but I don't have the main ingredient: mushrooms.
scripts.translation: 我手頭的食材只夠做蘑菇湯，偏偏連主料蘑菇都沒有。

scripts.text: Bring me 60 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶60個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}

scripts.text: Bring me {0} {1} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation: 從米德加爾特給我帶個。大城市的商人那裡就能買到。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: Whew, thank you. This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation: 呼，謝謝你。這些食材今天應該夠用了。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我帶的物品種類太多了。得先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: Sorry, but we need someone stronger than you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我們需要比你更強的人。

scripts.text: Hey, buddy. You look pretty strong. You're here to work, right?
scripts.translation: 嘿，朋友，你看起來挺強壯的。是來幹活的吧？

scripts.text: Come on, don't be so heartless. I'm trying to strike up a conversation here. I've got a proposition that you might be interested. What do you say?
scripts.translation: 別這麼冷淡嘛，我只是想和你聊聊。我有個你可能感興趣的提議，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Oh, you don't. *Smacks his lips* How disappointing!
scripts.translation: 哦，你沒興趣啊。*咂咂嘴* 真叫人失望！

scripts.text: Ah, so you're not as snobbish as I thought.
scripts.translation: 啊，看來你沒我想的那麼傲慢。

scripts.text: For Rock Ridge to become a transport hub, the monsters that live around it have got to go, but we can't find the right people for the job.
scripts.translation: 要讓洛克理奇成為交通樞紐，就得清除周邊的魔物，可我們一直找不到合適的人手。

scripts.text: *Snort* These? Yeah, we thought they were good enough until we realized how strong the monsters out there were.
scripts.translation: *哼* 他們？我們本來也以為他們能勝任，直到發現外面的魔物有多厲害。

scripts.text: None of these guys would come back alive, let alone earn their keep. And then we'd have to go out there to collect their remains, which is doubly bad for us.
scripts.translation: 這些人根本沒人能活著回來，更別說完成工作了。到時候我們還得出去收屍，對我們來說更是麻煩。

scripts.text: Then I saw you, and you stood out like a wolf among sheep. That is, you've passed! Congratulations!
scripts.translation: 然後我就看見了你。你在他們當中格外顯眼，簡直鶴立雞群。也就是說，你通過考驗了！恭喜！

scripts.text: I never said I wanted to work with you.
Ah, come on, don't be like that. Help this poor man out here.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，別這樣嘛。幫幫我這個可憐人吧。

scripts.text: Okay, okay, I understand if you're busy. But I'm offering you benefits both of us.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我知道你可能很忙。不過這提議對咱們雙方都有好處。

scripts.text: How about I show you the list of things you could do for us? If you're interested, come back later. I promise I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation: 這樣吧，我把能幫我們做的事列給你。感興趣的話，之後再來找我。我保證報酬豐厚。

scripts.text: The worst is over. I'll need your help again. Save your energy until then, alright?
scripts.translation: 最難熬的時期已經過去了。之後還得麻煩你幫忙。在那之前先養精蓄銳吧。

scripts.text: Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation: 忘了要做什麼了嗎？那我再告訴你一遍。

scripts.text: The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation: 這附近田野裡最大的威脅就是野牛強盜。他們既狡猾又殘暴，根本不聽人講道理。

scripts.text: And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation: 他們還時不時來襲擊村子，像是在試探我們能撐多久。

scripts.text: We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits with rifles^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們得殺雞儆猴，讓他們收斂些。去解決15個持步槍的野牛強盜。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.

scripts.translation: 我們得殺雞儆猴，讓他們收斂些。去解決15個戴紅面具的野牛強盜。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation: 這附近田野裡最大的威脅就是野牛強盜。他們既狡猾又殘暴，根本不聽人講道理。

scripts.text: We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們得殺雞儆猴，讓他們收斂些。去解決15個戴眼罩的野牛強盜。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation: 忘了要做什麼了嗎？那我再告訴你一遍。

scripts.text: The Cacti and the members of this village are on good terms, and recently more coyotes have been seen along the road that leads to their village.
scripts.translation: 仙人掌人和村民一向相處融洽，最近通往他們村子的路上卻出現了越來越多郊狼。

scripts.text: Coyotes aren't aggressive, but they still keep the Cacti from coming in and out of their village freely.
scripts.translation: 郊狼雖然不主動攻擊人，但害得仙人掌人沒法自由進出村子。

scripts.text: Please hunt ^0000ff20 Coyotes^000000 and help our friends.
scripts.translation: 請獵殺20只郊狼，幫幫我們的朋友。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: The workers who were sent down to the basement of the village went missing one after another, so we investigated. We believe they were killed by monsters.
scripts.translation: 派到村子地下室的工人接連失蹤，我們調查後發現，他們很可能是被魔物殺害了。

scripts.text: Swamp Arclouzes are fast, carnivorous insects living down there, and their number has been increasing at such an alarming rate that workers now refuse to go in there to work.
scripts.translation: 沼澤卷甲蟲是地下室裡行動迅速的肉食性昆蟲，數量正以驚人的速度增加，工人們都不敢下去幹活了。

scripts.text: If you have business down there, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffSwamp Arclouzes^000000.
scripts.translation: 如果你要下去辦事，請消滅10只沼澤卷甲蟲。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: The bodies of the workers who went missing in the basement have been found. They were mangled so badly that even their families had a hard time recognizing them.
scripts.translation: 失蹤工人的屍體已經在地下室找到了。他們被撕咬得面目全非，連家人都難以辨認。

scripts.text: I think they were killed by brown rats that thrive in the basement. Rumor has it they even attack living people, and if it holds true, that's serious.
scripts.translation: 我覺得是地下室裡氾濫的褐鼠殺了他們。聽說那些老鼠甚至會襲擊活人，要是真的就麻煩了。

scripts.text: If you have business in the basement, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffBrown Rats^000000.
scripts.translation: 如果你要去地下室，請消滅10只褐鼠。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: You're amazing? I didn't know you could really do this! Thanks!
scripts.translation: 你真行啊！沒想到你真能辦到！多謝了！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我帶的物品種類太多了。得先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: Hah hah, thank you for your interest, but we're not desperate enough to need help from little kids like you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，多謝你有這份心，不過我們還沒落魄到要找你這種小孩幫忙。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou must be Level 140 or above to receive this quest.^000000
scripts.translation: 需要達到140級或更高等級才能接取此任務。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Mm? You're not one of us. If you need a job, then you should look elsewhere.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你不是我們義警隊的人。想找活幹的話，去別處看看吧。

scripts.text: You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation: 你幹得不錯。希望下次還能合作。

scripts.text: You're pretty strong. Can you handle something tough?
scripts.translation: 你挺強的，能接下棘手的活嗎？

scripts.text: Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation: 忘了要做什麼了嗎？那我再告訴你一遍。

scripts.text: Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation: 精英野牛強盜是強盜中的頭目，這次要對付的就是他們。

scripts.text: You've dealt with the buffaloes with rifles before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those with ^0000ffglowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation: 你之前對付過持步槍的野牛強盜吧？那肯定見過那些雙眼泛著藍光的傢伙。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: They're the middle-ranking officers of rifle buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffrifle Buffalo Bandits with glowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation: 他們是持步槍強盜裡的中層頭目。去解決10只雙眼泛藍光的持步槍野牛強盜。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation: 精英野牛強盜是強盜中的頭目，這次要對付的就是他們。

scripts.text: You've dealt with the masked buffaloes before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffgreen masks^000000.
scripts.translation: 你之前對付過戴面具的野牛強盜吧？那肯定見過那些戴著綠面具的傢伙。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: They're the middle-ranking officers of masked buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing green masks^000000.
scripts.translation: 他們是戴面具強盜裡的中層頭目。去解決10只戴綠面具的野牛強盜。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation: 精英野牛強盜是強盜中的頭目，這次要對付的就是他們。

scripts.text: You've dealt with the buffaloes with an eye patch before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffpale green vests^000000.
scripts.translation: 你之前對付過戴眼罩的野牛強盜吧？那肯定見過那些穿著淺綠色背心的傢伙。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: They're the middle-ranking officers of sword buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch and a pale green vest^000000.
scripts.translation: 他們是持劍強盜裡的中層頭目。去解決10只戴眼罩、穿淺綠色背心的野牛強盜。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Some miners have reported to us about gas-like monsters that spread a neurotoxin.
scripts.translation: 有礦工報告說，出現了一種會散播神經毒素的氣體狀魔物。

scripts.text: They're purple monsters named Gasters. They don't attack unless they're provoked, but they still pose a threat.
scripts.translation: 那是紫色的瓦斯魔。只要不招惹它們，它們就不會攻擊，但仍然很危險。

scripts.text: Please hunt 10 ^0000ffGasters^000000 in the mine outside the village.
scripts.translation: 請到村外的礦場獵殺10只瓦斯魔。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation: 你幹得不錯。希望下次還能合作。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我帶的物品種類太多了。得先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了，最好先清出些背包空間。

scripts.text: What are you doing here? You're not good enough to earn your keep. Out!
scripts.translation: 你在這兒幹什麼？你根本不夠格領工錢。出去！

scripts.text: My office is filled with thieves. Everyone expects to be paid? Without doing their job!
scripts.translation: 我辦公室裡全是想白拿錢的小偷！人人都想領工資，卻沒人肯幹活！

scripts.text: And you. How much were you going to ask me for? Just so you know, we don't allow payroll advances.
scripts.translation: 還有你，你想跟我要多少錢？先說好，我們不準預支工資。

scripts.text: I want 100 million Zeny in advance.
Mm? But you look too strong to be a simple passersby.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你看起來這麼強，可不像普通路人。

scripts.text: Well, I don't have any business here. I should go.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我沒什麼事，還是走吧。

scripts.text: Hey, Jamie! How many more workers did you say we need in the culvert?
scripts.translation: 傑米！你說排水溝那邊還缺多少工人？

scripts.text: ^000077Since 2 more disappeared yesterday, 15. No one wants to go down there.^000000
scripts.translation: 昨天又有2個人失蹤了，所以還缺15個。沒人願意下去。 ^000077^000000

scripts.text: Hear that? Our office is severely understaffed.
scripts.translation: 聽見了吧？我們這邊嚴重缺人。

scripts.text: But what about all these people who are eager to work?
scripts.translation: 可這裡不是有這麼多人搶著要工作嗎？

scripts.text: Hey, come on! I'm not finished!
scripts.translation: 喂，別急著走！我還沒說完！

scripts.text: They're eager, all right, but none of them is strong enough to be useful.
scripts.translation: 他們是很積極，可惜一個個都不夠強，派不上用場。

scripts.text: We need a lot of people at a construction site. It's... a little bit dangerous down there, but you look like you know how to deal with danger.
scripts.translation: 工地需要不少人手。下面...確實有點危險，不過看你挺會應付危險的。

scripts.text: Say, how'd you like to work for me? I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣，要不要來給我幹活？報酬豐厚哦。

scripts.text: Tell me what this job entails.
scripts.translation: 先告訴我這工作具體要做什麼。

scripts.text: You don't have to think! This benefits both of us!
scripts.translation: 這還用考慮？對咱們雙方都有好處！

scripts.text: Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation: 我先介紹一下這個村子。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遺蹟上。

scripts.text: We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation: 地下室裡裝著海水淡化裝置，所以不能把那裡完全填起來。

scripts.text: Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation: 我先介紹一下這個村子。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遺蹟上。

scripts.text: We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation: 地下室裡裝著海水淡化裝置，所以不能把那裡完全填起來。

scripts.text: This area is a desert. Desalinating is cheaper than importing water.
scripts.translation: 這裡是沙漠。海水淡化比從外地運水便宜。

scripts.text: Anyway, the desalination system itself is in good order, but the cobweb of pipes that forms the system is prone to erosion and breakage. They need constant maintenance.
scripts.translation: 總之，裝置本身運作正常，但組成系統的管道網很容易被侵蝕或損壞，必須經常維護。

scripts.text: Then some time ago, monsters started showing up in the basement, and now our workers are too scared to work. That's the situation we're in right now.
scripts.translation: 可前陣子地下室開始出現魔物，工人們現在都嚇得不敢幹活了。眼下就是這麼個情況。

scripts.text: What happens if I say no?
This village will run out of drinking water. Someone has to do this. Believe it or not, I'm doing doing this entirely for profit.
scripts.translation: 村裡就會沒有飲用水。總得有人去做。信不信由你，我可不是為了賺錢才這麼忙活的。

scripts.text: Say, is that good enough motivation for you? If you still don't want to help us, I won't force you.
scripts.translation: 這理由夠打動你了嗎？你要是不願意幫忙，我也不勉強。

scripts.text: ^000077Mr. Chairman, I've just got a call from the basement. Five more workers have been attacked by monsters.^000000
scripts.translation: 主席先生，我剛接到地下室打來的電話。又有5名工人遭到魔物襲擊。 ^000077^000000

scripts.text: Uh-oh, I'd better go take care of that situation. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 糟了，我得去處理一下。改變主意的話再回來找我。

scripts.text: Aren't you tired? The pipes don't need cleaning at this moment. Why don't you go take care of whatever else you have to do?
scripts.translation: 你不累嗎？現在不用清理管道。先去處理別的事情吧。

scripts.text: Does this mean you're willing to go downstairs?
Good. Let me tell you what to do. Take a look at the door at the bottom of the water storage to the left side of me. It's connected to the basement.
scripts.translation: 好，我來告訴你該做什麼。看看我左手邊水槽底部那扇門，它通往地下室。

scripts.text: Do you mean the door that looks like a portal?
scripts.translation: 你是說那扇像傳送門一樣的門嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. Usually it's closed, and only those who have business in the basement can use it,
scripts.translation: 沒錯。平時那扇門是關著的，只有需要去地下室工作的人才能進去，

scripts.text: You know, people who help the Vigilantes, clean the sewer, and maintain the desalination pipes, like you.
scripts.translation: 比如幫義警做事、清理下水道、維護海水淡化管道的人。現在你也要做這些。

scripts.text: Your job is to find four different types of pipes and fasten their bolts to prevent leakage.
scripts.translation: 你要找出四種不同的管道，把螺栓擰緊，防止漏水。

scripts.text: The pipes that need maintenance are colored differently for easy recognition. When you're ready, enter the door on the left side.
scripts.translation: 需要維護的管道顏色各不相同，很容易辨認。準備好後就從左邊的門進去。

scripts.text: You haven't finished cleaning the pipes. We'll run out of water soon. Could you hurry up?
scripts.translation: 管道還沒修好嗎？村裡快沒水了，能不能抓緊一點？

scripts.text: Good job. The villagers can enjoy clean water for the rest of the day, and it's all because of you.
scripts.translation: 幹得好！多虧了你，村民今天剩下的時間都能用上乾淨水了。

scripts.text: Could you stop hitting on me? I'm the Chairman's personal secretary.
scripts.translation: 別再對我毛手毛腳了好嗎？我是主席的私人秘書。

scripts.text: ^0000ffWarning: This place is not for the weak or faint-hearted.^000000
scripts.translation: 警告：膽小或懦弱的人不宜進入此地。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: What are you looking at? Scram before I put holes in your face! Git!
scripts.translation: 看什麼看？再不滾我就在你臉上開幾個洞！滾！

scripts.text: I should go. He's just being stubborn.
scripts.translation: 我該走了。他就是在鬧脾氣。

scripts.text: Frankly, I don't understand why he would want to do this, but I don't want to stop him.
scripts.translation: 說實話，我不明白他為什麼非要這麼做，但我不想阻止他。

scripts.text: Demon, some strange kid is just hanging out around us. Do you know him?
scripts.translation: 惡魔，有個奇怪的小孩一直在我們附近晃悠。你認識他嗎？

scripts.text: Who? Where? I don't see him. Send him to me.
scripts.translation: 誰？在哪兒？我沒看見。讓他過來找我。

scripts.text: You're carrying so much stuff, I'm worried you might break your shoulder. Why don't you go lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation: 你帶這麼多東西，我都擔心你會壓傷肩膀。先清出些背包空間吧。

scripts.text: You're still wet behind the ears. This place is too dangerous for you. Come back later, alright?
scripts.translation: 你還嫩著呢，這裡太危險了。過些時候再來，好嗎？

scripts.text: You have no idea how dangerous this place is, do you? Get out of here while you can.
scripts.translation: 你根本不知道這裡有多危險吧？趁還能走，趕緊離開。

scripts.text: You came back quickly. Ah, I miss being young.
scripts.translation: 你這麼快就回來了。唉，真懷念年輕的時候。

scripts.text: But look, I still have left some of the materials you brought me yesterday. I can't use all these.
scripts.translation: 不過你看，昨天帶來的材料我還剩下一些，根本用不完。

scripts.text: Why don't you go home and come back next morning?
scripts.translation: 先回家吧，明天早上再來。

scripts.text: Hey, kiddo! It's very nice to see you again. The bomb I made with the materials you brought is in the aging process. Did you know wine and bombs get better the older they are?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小傢伙！很高興又見到你。你帶來的材料做成的炸彈正在熟化呢。你知道嗎，酒和炸彈一樣，放得越久越夠味？

scripts.text: Now, could you bring some more materials today? We're a long way from having all the bombs we need.
scripts.translation: 今天能再帶些材料來嗎？我們離湊齊需要的炸彈還差得遠呢。

scripts.text: As usual, get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation: 照舊，帶來10份毒藥粉和1份爆炸粉，再獵殺15只瓦斯魔。明白了嗎？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We'll be counting on you, kiddo!
scripts.translation: 小傢伙，這事就拜託你啦！

scripts.text: Alright, this should do. You know what I need, right? Are you sure you could sneak in? Maybe I should go.
scripts.translation: 好，這些應該夠了。你知道我需要什麼吧？你確定能悄悄溜進去嗎？要不還是我去吧。

scripts.text: I'll go while everyone's in bed.
scripts.translation: 等大家睡著了，我就進去。

scripts.text: But the noise could wake them up. There'll be guards, too.
scripts.translation: 可動靜可能會把他們吵醒，而且裡面還有守衛。

scripts.text: I'll be alright. We all look alike? They won't know I'm not one of them.
scripts.translation: 沒事，我們長得都差不多，他們認不出我不是自己人。

scripts.text: Mister, what are you doing here?
Why are you playing with fire in the middle of nowhere? You're suspicious.
scripts.translation: 你們為什麼在荒郊野外玩火？看起來很可疑啊。

scripts.text: Hey, a kid is asking you a question. He looks so curious that I'm worried he might die if you don't tell him.
scripts.translation: 喂，這孩子在問你呢。他好奇得不得了，你不告訴他，我擔心他會急壞的。

scripts.text: Little kids like him are full of curiosity. You'd better tell him before he starts crying.
scripts.translation: 這孩子好奇心得很。趁他還沒哭，你最好告訴他吧。

scripts.text: No. Why should I? He asked you. Plus, kids usually give me heartburn.
scripts.translation: 我才不說，憑什麼？是他問你的。而且小孩總讓我頭疼。

scripts.text: I had my favorite bean dish for breakfast today. I can't lose it. I want it to become part of me.
scripts.translation: 我今天早餐吃了最喜歡的豆子料理，可捨不得浪費。我想把它消化吸收，變成身體的一部分。

scripts.text: Some of it has to come out of you eventually. Poor beans. They'd be angry to be eaten by jerks like you.
scripts.translation: 反正最後總得排出來。可憐的豆子，竟被你這種混蛋吃掉，肯定氣壞了。

scripts.text: Oh, right! Why don't we ask this kid?
scripts.translation: 哦，對了！不如問問這孩子？

scripts.text: What? But we can't trust him? We've just met him!
scripts.translation: 什麼？我們能信任他嗎？我們才剛認識！

scripts.text: Yes, we can. People are supposed to trust each other. You didn't know that, did you? Now that he's here, he's one of us now. And I told you, everyone's born good.
scripts.translation: 當然能。人與人本來就該互相信任嘛，你不知道嗎？他既然來了，就是我們的人了。我早告訴過你，人人生來都是善良的。

scripts.text: Plus, doesn't he look like he's used to rough things? He has a runner's body and keen eyes that miss nothing. I like kids like him.
scripts.translation: 而且這孩子看起來吃得了苦。他身手敏捷，眼神也銳利，什麼都逃不過他的眼睛。我喜歡這樣的孩子。

scripts.text: Hey, kiddo. How'd you like to join us in business?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小傢伙，想不想加入我們一起做生意？

scripts.text: You look dangerous. I don't want to do anything dangerous.
scripts.translation: 你們看起來很危險，我可不想幹危險的事。

scripts.text: You don't? Alright, then I won't force you. Take care now. This place is dangerous. You'd better get out of here.
scripts.translation: 不想啊？好吧，我不勉強你。保重，這裡很危險，最好趕緊離開。

scripts.text: Are you sure we can let him go? He's seen us.
scripts.translation: 真要放他走？他都看見我們了。

scripts.text: Why are you so paranoid? It's okay, kiddo. Just go. But come back if you change your mind!
scripts.translation: 你也太疑神疑鬼了。沒事的，小傢伙，走吧。改變主意的話再回來！

scripts.text: Unless you're going to explain it yourself, just shut up and let me do it!
scripts.translation: 你要是不打算親自解釋，就閉嘴讓我來說！

scripts.text: That's more like it. Anyway, we're going to rob the ^0000cdmine^000000.
scripts.translation: 這才像話。總之，我們要去搶礦場。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You didn't have to tell him that. You could've just asked him to get the things for us.
scripts.translation: 你沒必要告訴他這些，直接讓他幫我們拿東西不就行了。

scripts.text: We can't make him do things for us without explanation. He has the right to know what he's getting himself into.
scripts.translation: 總不能什麼都不解釋就讓他替我們做事吧。他有權知道自己要摻和什麼。

scripts.text: You want to take advantage of a stranger.
scripts.translation: 你就是想利用這個陌生人。

scripts.text: No. I'm asking you to be in on our great plan. Anyway, you know the mine east of here? It used to belong to Gold Moon?
scripts.translation: 才不是，我是在邀請你加入我們的絕妙計劃。對了，你知道這附近東邊的礦場嗎？以前是金月的。

scripts.text: So, anyway, the Buffalo Bandits realized how lucrative the mine was and took up residence in there.
scripts.translation: 後來野牛強盜發現礦場很賺錢，就佔下來住進去了。

scripts.text: Hey, did you just get released? So are we! In fact, we've met there. I've met most of my best friends while we were in the system.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你剛放出來嗎？我們也是！說起來，我們在裡面見過。我最好的幾個朋友都是在牢裡認識的。

scripts.text: I miss the smell of the stone floor. And the coolness.
scripts.translation: 我還挺懷念石地板的氣味，還有那股涼意。

scripts.text: I liked the food, too. I hated beans until I went to jail. All the beans I've eaten aren't half as good as those I ate in there.
scripts.translation: 我也喜歡那裡的伙食。進監獄前我討厭豆子，可我吃過的豆子沒有一種比得上牢裡的。

scripts.text: Why did you go to jail?
Are you going to tell him that too?
Why not? I loved that story. You want to hear it, don't you?
scripts.translation: 為什麼不呢？我可喜歡講那個故事了。你也想聽吧？

scripts.text: I'm really good with my hands, and I like fireworks. What do you think would be the best job for someone like me?
scripts.translation: 我手很巧，又喜歡煙火。你覺得我這種人最適合做什麼工作？

scripts.text: Close, but I make something stronger: ^0000cdbombs^000000. And mines are just about the best thing that could happen to people like me.
scripts.translation: 差不多，不過我做的是更厲害的東西：炸彈。對我們這種人來說，礦場簡直是再好不過的地方。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: People working at the mines always need bombs. I came here, hoping I could make some money while doing what I love.
scripts.translation: 礦工總是需要炸彈。我來這裡就是想一邊做喜歡的事，一邊賺點錢。

scripts.text: And it's because of you! One night, some guys came to me and said they heard I was a bomb specialist. They demanded I donate bombs to them.
scripts.translation: 都怪你！有天晚上，幾個人來找我，說聽說我是炸彈專家，逼我捐些炸彈給他們。

scripts.text: One look at them, and I knew they were the infamous ^0000cdBuffalo Bandits^000000. It was obvious why they wanted my bombs.
scripts.translation: 我一看就知道他們是臭名昭著的野牛強盜。他們要我的炸彈幹什麼，顯而易見。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And you still gave them to them.
What else could I do? A bunch of scary-looking buffaloes who were at least a head taller than me, mind you? Demanded I give them my bombs.
scripts.translation: 那我還能怎麼辦？那幫野牛一個個凶神惡煞，至少比我高出一頭，還命令我交出炸彈。

scripts.text: No, I couldn't have stood my ground. You weren't there. Anyway, those buffaloes used my bombs to blow up the ore train and take over the mine. Guess what happened to me afterward.
scripts.translation: 我哪敢跟他們對著幹？你當時又不在。總之，那些野牛用我的炸彈炸燬了礦石列車，佔領了礦場。猜猜後來我怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: The sheriff traced the bombs back to me and dragged me with him.
scripts.translation: 警長查到炸彈是我做的，就把我抓走了。

scripts.text: And you got thrown in jail.
And guess who I met there: this guy. He was caught in the explosion that blew up the train, and those heartless buffaloes left him to die.
scripts.translation: 猜猜我在那兒遇見了誰？就是這傢伙。他被炸燬列車時波及，那些冷血的野牛卻把他扔在那裡等死。

scripts.text: And the sheriffs were no better than them. They just left him bleeding all over the cell. What could I do? I couldn't let anyone die if I could help it, so I treated him.
scripts.translation: 警長也好不到哪去。他們就任由他在牢房裡血流不止。我能怎麼辦？只要還有辦法，我就不能見死不救，於是替他治了傷。

scripts.text: He's been following me around since then.
scripts.translation: 從那以後他就一直跟著我。

scripts.text: Yes. Or why did you save me when I came to the mine to get even with the buffaloes? They kicked you out because of me.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。要不然我來礦場找野牛報仇時，你為什麼救我？他們還因為我把你趕走了。

scripts.text: Did you get your revenge after you were released?
I don't want to talk about it. I made so many stupid mistakes, which wasn't like me at all. That's why we were hiding out in this dark, dank place.
scripts.translation: 我不想提那件事。我犯了太多蠢錯誤，根本不像平時的我。所以我們才躲在這個陰暗潮溼的地方。

scripts.text: So, what can I do to help?
Are you sure you want to help? Because I don't like forcing people, or sending them in harm's way. If you really want to help, then you can get some bomb materials for me.
scripts.translation: 你確定要幫忙？我不喜歡強迫別人，也不想讓人冒險。你真想幫的話，就替我找些炸彈材料吧。

scripts.text: Why, so you could rob the mine?
scripts.translation: 找材料是為了搶礦場嗎？

scripts.text: No. Technically speaking, we'd ^0000cdreclaim the mine^000000. Have you seen what's going in the village? Since those buffaloes took over the mine, most of the people lost their jobs.
scripts.translation: 不，嚴格來說，我們是要奪回礦場。你也看到村裡的情況了吧？野牛佔了礦場後，大多數人都失業了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Without a job, they can't make money, and without money, they can't feed themselves. This is terrible.
scripts.translation: 沒工作就賺不到錢，沒錢就沒飯吃。實在太糟了。

scripts.text: I want to throw a ^0000cdfirework party inside the mine^000000 and ^0000cdscare away the bandits^000000.
scripts.translation: 我想在礦場裡辦一場煙火派對，把強盜嚇跑。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But, Mr. Midnight, they used to be your...
scripts.translation: 可是，午夜先生，他們以前是你的...

scripts.text: Don't worry about him. He cut ties with them a long time ago. He has no love for those buffaloes who abandoned him. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 別管他。他早就和他們斷絕來往了，對拋棄自己的野牛也沒什麼感情。對吧？

scripts.text: Well, I'll be dipped in buttermilk.
No, I'm not worried about them, but I am worried about us. If this goes wrong?
scripts.translation: 我不是擔心他們，我是擔心我們。萬一計劃失敗了呢？

scripts.text: The sheriffs will throw us in jail if the bandits don't kill us. But it's okay. I like the beans there.
scripts.translation: 要是沒被強盜殺掉，我們就會被警長抓進監獄。不過沒關係，我喜歡牢裡的豆子。

scripts.text: If this goes well, we can get out of this cesspit and I can work at the mine again. So can you.
scripts.translation: 計劃順利的話，我們就能離開這個鬼地方，我也能回礦場工作。你也一樣。

scripts.text: Anyway, kiddo, are you sure you can help us? There are monsters inside the mine that looks like cotton balls. Hunt them, and they'll leave behind deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder.
scripts.translation: 小傢伙，你確定能幫我們嗎？礦場裡有些像棉花團一樣的魔物。獵殺它們就能拿到毒藥粉和爆炸粉。

scripts.text: I need 10 Deadly Poison Powders and.. let me see.. 1 Explosive Powder.
scripts.translation: 我需要10份毒藥粉，還有...讓我想想...1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text: Deadly poisonous powder? Are you going to kill them? You said you just want to scare them away.
scripts.translation: 毒藥粉？你要殺了他們嗎？你不是說只想把他們嚇跑嗎？

scripts.text: It's deadly only to humans and Dorams. To those Tauruses, it only causes allergic reactions, like itching and sneezing.
scripts.translation: 這東西只對人類和多蘭族致命。那些牛頭人只會過敏，發癢、打噴嚏而已。

scripts.text: No. You're going to get caught and ruin our plan before it even begins.
scripts.translation: 不行，你會被抓，計劃還沒開始就得泡湯。

scripts.text: Ah kiddo, speaking of which, could you cull some Gasters? That'll help us set up bombs later.
scripts.translation: 啊，對了小傢伙，你能順便清理些瓦斯魔嗎？之後佈置炸彈時用得上。

scripts.text: The buffaloes would get out of the mine when the fireworks starts, but those clumps of gas could trigger chain reaction and blow up the entire mine. Hunt 15 of them for now. Can you do it?
scripts.translation: 煙火一放，野牛就會逃出礦場。不過那些氣團可能引發連鎖爆炸，把整個礦場炸飛。先獵殺15只吧，能辦到嗎？

scripts.text: I asked yes or no. Oh well, I'll take that as a yes.
scripts.translation: 我問你行不行呢。算了，我就當你答應了。

scripts.text: Now, here's the lowdown: get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation: 我說說具體要做什麼：帶來10份毒藥粉和1份爆炸粉，另外獵殺15只瓦斯魔。明白了嗎？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We'll be counting on you, kiddo! I'll repay you generously when you come back. I was able to nab a few things while in jail at the sheriff's office. Now, off you go!
scripts.translation: 小傢伙，這事就拜託你啦！回來後我會好好答謝你。我在警長辦公室坐牢時順了幾樣東西。好了，出發吧！

scripts.text: Let's see... Mm, kiddo, you forgot to hunt all the Gasters. We can't have Gasters around while we work.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，小傢伙，你還沒把瓦斯魔都清理掉。幹活時可不能讓它們留在附近。

scripts.text: Hunt just 15 Gasters. There's no rush. You can take your time. Just come back before the end of the day today. I want to see you again.
scripts.translation: 獵殺15只瓦斯魔就行，不用著急。今天結束前回來就好，我還想再見你一面。

scripts.text: Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 10 Deadly Poison Powders. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，你還沒帶來10份毒藥粉。這是做炸彈所需的最低數量。

scripts.text: Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation: 小傢伙，這點事難不倒你吧？去瓦斯魔身上找10份毒藥粉和1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text: Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 1 Explosive Powder. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，你還沒帶來1份爆炸粉。這是做炸彈所需的最低數量。

scripts.text: Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation: 小傢伙，這點事難不倒你吧？去瓦斯魔身上找1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text: Let's see... Ooh, kiddo, you got everything done! You hunted Gasters and brought what I asked.
scripts.translation: 我看看...哇，小傢伙，你全都辦妥了！瓦斯魔也獵殺了，東西也帶齊了。

scripts.text: This is enough to keep me awake all night.
scripts.translation: 這些夠我興奮得一整晚睡不著了。

scripts.text: Hey kiddo, do you mind helping me again tomorrow? I need more than one bomb to throw a firework party.
scripts.translation: 嘿，小傢伙，明天還能再幫我一次嗎？辦煙火派對可不止要一顆炸彈。

scripts.text: Go rest today and come back tomorrow in the morning. See ya!
scripts.translation: 今天先去休息，明天早上再來。回頭見！

scripts.text: Aww, just one look at them,
and all I want to do is sneeze...
What are you looking at? Were you eavesdropping on me?
scripts.translation: 看什麼看？你在偷聽我說話嗎？趕

scripts.text: Get your butt outta here! Git!
Oh, you want to help me again.
Thanks, but I only have to patrol once a day. Why don't you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.?
scripts.translation: 次啊。謝了，不過我一天只巡邏一次。明天凌晨4點後再來吧。

scripts.text: Ah, stranger! You came to help again, right?
scripts.translation: 啊，陌生人！你又來幫忙了，對吧？

scripts.text: Why not? Are you too busy today?
scripts.translation: 怎麼不幫了？今天有事嗎？

scripts.text: Don't worry about your payment; I've got it covered. Just go get the job done.
scripts.translation: 報酬不用擔心，我會負責。你只管把事情辦好。

scripts.text: Maybe I should take a giant fan with me.
scripts.translation: 麼辦？要不帶把大風扇過去？不

scripts.text: No. No, then everyone will find out.
scripts.translation: 行，那樣大家都會發現的。誰

scripts.text: Mm? I'm pretty sure I haven't seen you around.
You're not one of the vigilantes.

scripts.translation: 直來壞我們好事的陌生人！

scripts.text: Yes, those clumps of gas. They make me sneeze something fierce,
scripts.translation: 沒錯，就是那些氣團。害我不停打噴嚏，弄

scripts.text: and turn into a weeping, drooling, sniffling mess. *Shudder*
scripts.translation: 得眼淚鼻涕直流，狼狽不堪。*打了個寒顫*

scripts.text: Now, I've been assigned to go on patrol inside the mine, and I can't do it because of them.
scripts.translation: 我被派去礦場巡邏，可那些東西害我根本沒法去。我們

scripts.text: But we Taurases take pride in our physical superiority. How can I tell the others that I can't do my job because I'm allergic to some gas?
scripts.translation: 牛頭人一向以體格強壯為傲，我怎麼能告訴別人，我因為對某種氣體過敏才沒法工作？

scripts.text: Hunt ^FF000020 Gasters^000000 before I get in there.
scripts.translation: 在我進去前，先獵殺20只瓦斯魔 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Come on, I said I'd repay you.
Bah! Alright, then I won't force you.
But you'd better not tell anyone about this. Got it?
scripts.translation: 。不過這事可別告訴別人，聽見了嗎？

scripts.text: Really? Thanks! I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？謝謝！就拜託你了！

scripts.text: Oh, and make sure no one knows about this.
scripts.translation: 對了，千萬別讓別人知道。

scripts.text: That'll be bad for both of us.
How many Gasters did you hunt?
scripts.translation: 你獵殺了多少隻瓦斯魔？

scripts.text: I'm ready to go on patrol. Let me know when you're done.
scripts.translation: 我已經準備好去巡邏了。你完成後告訴我。

scripts.text: I'll be counting on you, stranger.
scripts.translation: 陌生人，一切就拜託你了。

scripts.text: Did you hunt all of them? By the way, why are you carrying so much stuff?
scripts.translation: 都獵殺完了嗎？對了，你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？先去

scripts.text: Did you catch them all? I'd better finish my rounds before more of them spring up.
scripts.translation: 都解決了嗎？趁它們還沒再冒出來，我得趕緊巡邏。謝了

scripts.text: If you're not busy, come by tomorrow and help me again. I'll repay you.
scripts.translation: 有空的話明天再來幫我一次吧，我會付你報酬。

scripts.text: This works for both of us, don't you agree?
scripts.translation: 這對我們雙方都有好處，對吧？

scripts.text: Hello. Are you new to this place? You should be ^FF0000at least Level 100^000000 to stay here comfortably?
scripts.translation: 你好，是新來這裡的嗎？想在這裡待得舒坦，至少得達到100級吧？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Wait, what is my husband feeding that dog? Honey! That was our dinner!
scripts.translation: 等等，我丈夫在喂那隻狗什麼？親愛的！那是我們的晚飯！

scripts.text: S-sweetheart, you shouldn't be outside when it's so windy. Let's go in.
scripts.translation: 親愛的，風這麼大，你不該待在外面。我們進屋吧。

scripts.text: Grr, I can't believe you! You're getting only half your dinner tonight!
scripts.translation: 哼，真不敢相信你！今晚你只能吃一半的晚飯！

scripts.text: He's an angel when he's in sleep, but... sigh... I already have a headache, just thinking about what he might do when he wakes up ^FF0000after 4:00 a.m.^000000
scripts.translation: 他睡著時簡直像個天使，可是...唉...一想到他凌晨4點醒來後又會幹出什麼事，我就頭疼。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for coming back. We've checked all the holes Spotty dug inside the village, but we couldn't find what we were looking for. He must have taken it to the wasteland.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，謝謝你回來。我們檢查了斑點在村裡挖的所有坑，都沒找到要找的東西。它肯定把東西叼到荒地去了。

scripts.text: As I told you before, we've got something for you this time: ^0000CD1 Rock Ridge Coin^000000. Say, could you help us?
scripts.translation: 就像之前說的，這次我們會給你1枚洛克理奇硬幣。對了，你能幫我們嗎？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: We have no one else to turn to. Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 我們實在找不到別人幫忙了。改變主意的話，請再來找我們。

scripts.text: Today Spotty took a {0}. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation: 斑點今天叼走了一個。你能幫忙找找嗎？雖然這東西不難買，但我總不能每次它叼走東西都去買新的。 {0}

scripts.text: Go outside the village and talk to my husband. He'll tell you where it might be.
scripts.translation: 去村外找我丈夫談談，他會告訴你東西可能在哪兒。

scripts.text: Spotty would be a perfect dog if he doesn't take things out of the house. Sigh...
scripts.translation: 要是斑點不把家裡的東西叼出去，它就真是隻完美的狗了。唉...

scripts.text: After all the time we spent searching the village, we've found it inside his house.
scripts.translation: 指了！在村裡找了半天，最後竟然在他家裡找到了。

scripts.text: By the way, what's that shining thing in your hand?
scripts.translation: 對了，你手裡那個閃閃發亮的東西是什麼？

scripts.text: Oh, you want to ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first before showing it to me. Sure!
scripts.translation: 哦，你想先清出些背包空間再給我看啊。好吧！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: This is a Rock Ridge Coin. You can use it like money inside the village. I wasn't comfortable letting you help us for free. I'm glad you can at least have this.
scripts.translation: 這是一枚洛克理奇硬幣，在村子裡可以當錢用。我不想讓你白幫忙，能收下這個就好。

scripts.text: That Rock Ridge Coin is yours. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 這枚洛克理奇硬幣給你了，謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text: And, mm... Do you mind helping us again tomorrow? Spotty keeps taking things from the house to the wasteland, and we need them back.
scripts.translation: 還有...你明天能再幫我們一次嗎？斑點總把家裡的東西叼到荒地去，我們得把東西找回來。

scripts.text: Spotty tired itself out and fell asleep. Could you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.? We'll have something to give you next time.
scripts.translation: 斑點累得睡著了。明天凌晨4點以後再來好嗎？下次我們會給你準備謝禮。

scripts.text: Did you find what we asked? I can't see it because you're carrying too much stuff with you. Could you ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first?
scripts.translation: 找到我們要的東西了嗎？你帶的東西太多，我看不清。能先清出些背包空間嗎？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: You've found it! Thank you so much. We've been trying to correct Spotty's behavior, and it's difficult.
scripts.translation: 找到了！太感謝你了。我們一直在努力改掉斑點的壞習慣，可真不容易。

scripts.text: Here's the Rock Ridge Coin we promised. Thank you for searching the wasteland for us.
scripts.translation: 這是答應給你的洛克理奇硬幣。謝謝你替我們去荒地找東西。

scripts.text: Could you come back again? If you're not busy, you're welcome anytime after 4:00 a.m each day.
scripts.translation: 還願意再來幫忙嗎？有空的話，每天凌晨4點以後都歡迎你。

scripts.text: How many times do I have to tell you to keep your dog away from our things? Do you really want me to send it away on a ship?
scripts.translation: 我得說多少次才行，別讓你的狗碰我們的東西？你真想讓我把它裝船送走嗎？

scripts.text: Why? What did he do this time?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？它這次又闖什麼禍了？

scripts.text: I can't live like this anymore! Guess what Spotty stole this time? My ring!
scripts.translation: 我再也受不了了！猜猜斑點這次偷了什麼？我的戒指！

scripts.text: HONEY! Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation: 親愛的！你到底有沒有在聽我說話？！

scripts.text: My mom gave me that ring before I left for this foreign land. I was keeping it for a rainy day, and that mongrel stole it from me!
scripts.translation: 那是我離開故鄉來這片異鄉之前，媽媽送我的戒指。我一直留著以防萬一，結果那隻狗竟然把它偷走了！

scripts.text: You mean the gold ring you love? Uh-oh, Spotty is in big trouble.
scripts.translation: 你是說你最喜歡的那枚金戒指？糟了，斑點這次要倒大黴了。

scripts.text: I tried to be understanding when it took our shoes and laundry and buried them in the ground, but no, not my ring!
scripts.translation: 它把我們的鞋子和衣服叼走埋起來時，我都儘量體諒它了，可這次不行！它竟然偷我的戒指！

scripts.text: Sweetheart, please calm down. Is it possible you left it where he could reach it?
scripts.translation: 親愛的，先冷靜一下。有沒有可能是你把戒指放在它夠得到的地方了？

scripts.text: Are you kidding me? I never take it off except when I do the dishes or laundry,
scripts.translation: 你開玩笑嗎？我只有洗碗或洗衣服時才會摘下來，而

scripts.text: and even then I keep it in my pocket. I dropped it just this once, and that mongrel got ahold of it!
scripts.translation: 且也會放進口袋。就那一次不小心掉了，馬上就被那隻狗叼走了！

scripts.text: It's been two months since you quit your job, and instead of helping around the house, you've been spoiling that dog. You're responsible for its misbehavior!
scripts.translation: 你辭職都兩個月了，不幫忙做家務，倒是整天寵那隻狗。它會變成這樣都怪你！

scripts.text: I saw it run to the wasteland. Go find my ring. You'd better not come back home without it!
scripts.translation: 我看見它跑去荒地了。去把我的戒指找回來。找不到就別回家！

scripts.text: What? I'm a miner, not a fighter? I can't go out there! You know I couldn't stay out there long enough to find my hat when it flew away in that direction.
scripts.translation: 什麼？我是礦工，又不是打手，怎麼敢去那裡！你還記得我的帽子被風吹到那邊時，我連找都不敢多待一會兒。

scripts.text: I don't know, and I don't care!
- That's none of my business. I'm just going to pass. -
scripts.translation: - 這不關我的事，我還是不插手吧。 -

scripts.text: Ah, you're the adventurer who just arrived in these parts. Hah hah, don't be so surprised. I know because
scripts.translation: 啊，你就是剛來這一帶的冒險者。哈哈，別這麼驚訝，我知道是因為...

scripts.text: you sit by the dock all day, playing with the dog. Of course, I know everyone who comes and goes.
scripts.translation: 你整天坐在碼頭邊陪狗玩。來來往往的人，我當然都認識。

scripts.text: *Clenches his teeth* Sweetheart, let's not start it right now.
scripts.translation: *咬緊牙關* 親愛的，先別吵了。對了

scripts.text: Anyway, what can we do for you?
Say you want to help them find the ring.
scripts.translation: 告訴他們你願意幫忙找戒指。

scripts.text: Huh? You want to help us. Thank you, but no, thanks. We can't pay you.
scripts.translation: 什麼？你想幫我們？謝謝，不過不用了，我們付不起報酬。

scripts.text: And I know for a fact that no one offers help for free anymore.
scripts.translation: 而且我敢說，現在沒人會白白幫忙。

scripts.text: Wait, honey. You should think again. You and I are too afraid of the Buffalo Bandits to go out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation: 等等，親愛的，再想想。我們都怕野牛強盜，根本不敢去荒地。

scripts.text: We have no one else to turn to, and I can't think of a better way than this. Let's take a chance on this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我們也找不到別人幫忙，我想不出更好的辦法了。就相信這位冒險者一次吧。

scripts.text: Mm, Adventurer, let me take back what I just said. Please help us.
scripts.translation: 嗯，冒險者，剛才的話我收回。請幫幫我們。

scripts.text: Spotty digs holes and buries things in them every day. If you find holes in the wasteland, please look inside them.
scripts.translation: 斑點每天都會挖洞埋東西。你要是在荒地發現洞，幫忙看看裡面吧。

scripts.text: My husband and I will look around the village, just in case. If you find something, please come back here.
scripts.translation: 我和丈夫也會在村裡找找，以防萬一。找到東西的話，請回來告訴我們。

scripts.text: I picked up Spotty in the wasteland. Maybe that's why he loves spending time there so much. But he never ventures so far out that he can't make it home before it's mealtime. At least, not yet.
scripts.translation: 我是在荒地撿到斑點的，也許這就是它那麼愛往那兒跑的原因。不過它從不會跑得太遠，總會趕在吃飯前回家。至少目前是這樣。

scripts.text: Go out to the wasteland, and you'll see the marks that I've left on your map. You don't have to search any places beyond them.
scripts.translation: 去荒地後，你會看到我在地圖上標出的記號。搜到那些地方就夠了，不用再往外找。

scripts.text: Honey, you should at least follow the adventurer to the gates, so you could tell him where to look.
scripts.translation: 親愛的，你至少把冒險者送到大門口，告訴他該去哪裡找吧。

scripts.text: My wife said Spotty went out the back door and ran straight past the barbed-wire fence.
scripts.translation: 我妻子說斑點從後門溜出去，直接跑過了鐵絲網圍欄。

scripts.text: But he couldn't have gone too far because he came back to me pretty quickly. Why don't you walk along the fence and look for holes with white hair floating around them?
scripts.translation: 不過它應該沒跑太遠，因為很快就回來了。沿著圍欄找找看，留意附近有白毛的洞。

scripts.text: Did you find something? Then let's go back!
scripts.translation: 找到東西了嗎？那我們回去吧！

scripts.text: My wife sent me here to give you directions, but I have no idea where he might have been.
scripts.translation: 我妻子讓我來指路，可我也不知道它可能跑去哪兒了。

scripts.text: Oh, right! Spotty has been shedding a lot lately. Maybe you should look for holes with white hair floating around them.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了！斑點最近掉了很多毛。你可以找找周圍有白毛的洞。

scripts.text: And he doesn't seem to venture out too far. It's probably because he's still young. I've marked three possible locations in the middle of your map. You don't have to look further than those locations.
scripts.translation: 它好像不會跑得太遠，大概還小吧。我在地圖中間標了三個可能的位置，不用去那些地方以外搜。

scripts.text: Ah, Adventurer. Shhh! Please keep your voice down: the Buffalo Bandits might hear us.
scripts.translation: 啊，冒險者。噓！小聲點，野牛強盜可能會聽到我們。

scripts.text: I've been coming here whenever I can, to catch Spotty before he takes more things out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation: 我一有空就來這裡，想趁斑點再把東西叼去荒地前抓住它。

scripts.text: My wife says she'd throw him out, but she doesn't mean it. She never raises her hand no matter how angry she is with him either, and she always remembers to feed him vitamins and get him vaccinated.
scripts.translation: 我妻子嘴上說要把它趕出去，其實不會那麼做。不管多生氣，她也從沒打過它，還總記得給它吃維生素、帶它打疫苗。

scripts.text: She didn't say anything when I quit my job because I was too scared of the Buffalo Bandits. She's a good woman.
scripts.translation: 我因為害怕野牛強盜而辭職時，她一句怨言都沒有。她真是個好女人。

- There's a hole in the ground.
It only has wet soil inside it. -

scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面空空如也。 -

scripts.text: - I don't have to search farther than this. -
scripts.translation: - 不用再往更遠的地方找了。 -

It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面散落著幾縷白毛。 -

scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面有東西閃閃發亮，

I should take it with me for now. -

scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面有些東西。 -

scripts.text: - This must be what Mr. McPhy is looking for. I should bring it to her. -
scripts.translation: - 這肯定就是麥克菲夫人要找的東西。我該拿給她。 -

scripts.text: It only has a stone sticking out of the ground inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面只有一塊石頭從土裡露出來。 -

scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面有根小動物的骨頭。 -

scripts.text: It has a tumbleweed rolling around inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面有團風滾草在打轉。 -

scripts.text: A small insect is scuttling around inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面有隻小蟲子在爬。 -

scripts.translation: - 地上有個洞，裡面只長著雜草。 -
- 地上有個洞，裡面只有灰塵。 -
